subject: Renewal kickoff: three-phase expansion runway & QBR availability
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@tidalhealth.com>, Priyanka Shah <priyanka.shah@tidalhealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Aug 2029 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: three-phase expansion runway & QBR availability

Hi Alex / Priyanka —

Thanks again for a great conversation last week. As we discussed, I wanted to get a short kickoff thread started for the upcoming renewal and the proposed expansion (additional throughput + embeddings footprint). High level plan below — goal is to lock a QBR slot and agree on next 90-day milestones so we can size Dedicated capacity and finalize pricing.

Plan (proposed three-phase runway):
- Phase A (0–30 days): Confirm baseline usage, security checklist, and procurement window.
- Phase B (30–60 days): Trial uplift with a reserved GPU pool (staging), run perf tests and prompt regressions.
- Phase C (60–90 days): Production cutover to expanded capacity and formalize SLA/term changes.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please share your preferred QBR times next week (I attached an .ics poll).
2) Alex — can you confirm the internal procurement contact (CC’d Markus from procurement if helpful)?
3) Priyanka — do you have a quick snapshot of peak token/sec and embedding batch sizes so Sergio can pre-check sizing?

Attachments: TidalHealth_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (working MAP) and qbr-availability.ics (calendar poll).

I’ll set up a short 30-min kickoff once we get the QBR slot — goal: align stakeholders, confirm metrics to measure during Phase B, and lock procurement timelines.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Account Director | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

Rishi — thanks for the crisp plan.

Quick replies:
- QBR: We prefer Tue/Wed mornings (ET) next week. I completed the .ics poll as well.
- Procurement: Adding Markus from our procurement team on this thread (Markus, appreciate a heads up on typical lead times for reserved GPU capacity and any legal checklist items you need).
- Metrics: Priyanka will pull the last 60 days of peak throughput and sample embedding batch characteristics.

Two asks from our side before we kick off:
1) Can Redwood confirm the rollback strategy if Phase B perf regressions appear? (short paragraph will do)
2) We need a simple cost delta sheet showing current vs. expanded committed spend by month — happy for your ASR to share a draft.

Appreciate it — can join any 30-min kickoff Tue 09:00–11:00 ET.

Best,

Rishi / team — attaching the lightweight usage snapshot below (paste of our internal table):
- Current peak tokens/sec: ~1,100 (short spike tests hit 1,350 for ~20s)
- Typical embedding batch sizes: 128–256; avg latency constraints: <= 200ms for production calls
- Monthly token volume: ~95M tokens (ingest + generation)

Questions for Redwood:
- Sergio — will the 1,350 spike be handled by autoscaling within Phase B without manual intervention, or do we need a temporary burst capacity config?
- Laura — security: do you need any additional attestation docs for our regulator before we move to Dedicated?

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@tidalhealth.com>, Priyanka Shah <priyanka.shah@tidalhealth.com>

Date: Thu, 08 Aug 2029 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: three-phase expansion runway & QBR availability

Thanks all — good signals. Quick responses inline and next actions: 

- Rollback strategy (short): If Phase B reveals perf regressions we will (1) immediately divert new traffic to the current committed model variant, (2) pause the uplift job, (3) execute a fast rollback plan that restores the prior model binary and config within our SLA window. Sergio will own the runbook and can provide a <2-hour RTO in most cases.

- Cost delta: Laura and I will draft a month-by-month comparison (current vs. expanded committed) and share by end of day tomorrow.

- Autoscaling / burst: Sergio — short answer: Phase B supports autoscale to handle short spikes, but for predictable prolonged spikes we recommend enabling a burst-capacity reservation; I asked Sergio to propose thresholds based on Priyanka’s numbers.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Sergio: sizing note + recommended burst policy (ETA: 2029-08-09 EOD)
- Laura: regulator attestation checklist & SOC2 excerpt we can provide (ETA: 2029-08-09)
- Rishi: cost delta + updated MAP (ETA: 2029-08-09)
- Tidal ops: pick 2 QBR slots (Tue 09:00 ET or Wed 10:30 ET preferred)

I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Tue 09:30 ET if that works for Alex — holding a tentative block for now and will send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Attachments: updated MAP will be uploaded to the HubSpot link (see related links).

Thanks — look forward to the kickoff.

Rishi
Senior Account Director | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134
